summary: AI pit-strategy event handler, restricted to the player vehicle during an active race. If dword_7D0308 (race active) is nonzero, flt_7CF3C8 (track condition) is nonzero, dword_7C56A8 (race phase) is not 8, and the player vehicle's driver ID (at dword_7C54E8 + 18580) matches the vehicle's a1[4645] (this+0x4894), then: when pitting status a1[3348] (this+0x3450) equals 1, selects an event type (52 if this+0x4040 is 2 or -1, else 42), fills a local record via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion, and inserts it into the session event table via InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, record). Otherwise fires BooleanOROfTwoChecks(flt_5EA618, 42).

local_names.v3: selected event type (42 default, 52 when pit strategy type is 2 or -1)
local_names.v4: local event record buffer filled by DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion

Read v1 = a1[4112] (this+0x4040); default v3 = 42; if v1 == 2 or v1 == -1, set v3 = 52.
If pitting: fill the local event record via DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion(v4, v3, -1, -1, -1, -1, -2.0, -2.0).
If pitting: insert the event record into the session event table via InsertDriverTableEntry(flt_5EA618, v4).
If not pitting: fire the Boolean OR check BooleanOROfTwoChecks(flt_5EA618, 42).
